proof.pattern: kill-switch prior close for .* \(fully sold held-over lot\)

expected_rate: once per symbol on each session in which a lot held overnight is fully sold (the Swing trend-night QQQM lot sells most mornings it fills)
window_reason: The trend-night QQQM buy at the close does not fill every day (0/6, 0/5, 0/4, 1/4 on 11-05..11-10), so three sessions are needed to see one morning sale.
reversal: an 'exact tier attribution is unresolved' error after a 'prior close for' line on the same day, or a measured kill P&L that differs from the fills-based P&L by more than qty times a few cents
